commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished app overview cover, landscape 3:2 aspect ratio, high resolution (aim 1536x1024). All input images are reference material: first is the approved Belgium cover for coherent visual style and lighting, second is original project drawing style, third is original character design. Match the approved cover's detailed semi-realistic PAINTED adventure-game style: clean architectural drawing, soft cel-painted shading, dimensional stone and foliage, atmospheric depth, crisp recognizable buildings, blue-hour sky, softly gold-lit city, deep navy shadows, cool cyan magic, subtle violet in distance. Landmarks take 75% of attention. Full bleed environment, no borders or frames, no badge/icon, no collage panels, no typography, no names, no logos, no watermarks. Harmonize subjects into a coherent art-directed vista; preserve distinctive architecture while accepting geographic montage for country covers. Lower-left quieter dark foreground for app-rendered title, no painted text. At lower-right place small friendly Aero, 15% of image area maximum, teal beaked head, slate scaled serpent body, lavender belly, exactly TWO swept-back GOLDEN horns, purple eyes, cyan rune lines, smiling closed mouth, no wings or limbs. Near Aero one small faceted blue Diamond Beacon hovering over thin cyan ring. Landmark architecture dominant, Aero and beacon secondary. Keep consistent character size, twilight grading, camera height and level of detail across this collection. No giant people, no aggressive monsters, no futuristic replacements of historic buildings.
